parse_bioassembly_from_mmcif: construct a BioassemblyData instance from an mmCIF object using the from_mmcif class method
apply_transform_to_coords: apply a Transform operations sequence to 3D coordinates using the apply_to_coords method
get_transforms_for_assembly: get the list of Transform objects needed to generate a specific bioassembly by assembly ID
rename_label_asym_ids: rename chain label_asym_ids in BioassemblyData using a mapping and filter by present chains
convert_bioassembly_to_mmcif_dict: export BioassemblyData back to an mmCIF-compatible dictionary using the to_mmcif_dict method
